description: This file defines the `ParagraphRenderer` class responsible for rendering Paragraph objects into RTF format within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for rendering styles, content, and managing contextual rendering based on paragraph type.

classes.name: ParagraphRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a Paragraph object into RTF format, handling style, content, and context-specific rendering logic within the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Entrypoint to render the paragraph into RTF, managing style presentation and conditional formatting based on paragraph context.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Handles rendering the actual content of the paragraph, including special handling for footnotes and line breaks.
